description: A utility class for merging multiple component mapping (.cmp) files used in KiCad projects. It reads specified source files, skips headers and footers, and writes a combined output file with a specific header and footer.

classes.name: CmpMergeTool
classes.description: A utility class providing a static main method to merge multiple component map files into a single output.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point for the tool that processes command-line arguments, reads source files, and writes the merged output.
